description: Website accessibility audit (a11y, WCAG compliance check): WCAG 2.1 level A and AA conformance of any live URL or raw HTML, tested with axe-core in a real headless browser. Returns every violation with rule id, impact, help text and affected node count. Deterministic rules; a check that cannot run returns an error, never a pass. $0.05 per call.
